welcome:
📁 FILEMASTER BOT

Hello! Welcome to FileMaster Bot.
Convert your files quickly and easily.
send_image:
🖼 Please send an image (JPG, PNG, WEBP).
You can send multiple. When finished send /done.
send_word: 📝 Please send a Word file (DOC or DOCX).
send_excel: 📊 Please send an Excel file (XLS or XLSX).
send_pdfs_merge:
📚 Send PDF files to merge.
Order will be preserved.
When finished send /done or press Done.
error_generic: ❌ An error occurred. Please try again.
error_file_too_large: ❌ File is too large. Maximum: {max} MB.
error_no_file: ❌ File not found. Please send again.
error_libreoffice: ❌ LibreOffice is not installed. Contact the administrator.
error_ghostscript: ❌ Ghostscript is not installed. PDF compression requires Ghostscript.
about:
ℹ️ FileMaster Bot

Professional free file converter bot.
Convert PDF, Word, Excel and images.

Built with 100% free technologies.

Version: 1.0.0
help:
📞 Help

1. Choose a service from the menu.
2. Send the required file.
3. Wait for the result.

Commands:
/start - Main menu
/help - Help
/done - Finish (merge / multiple images)
/cancel - Cancel

Contact admin for questions.
compress_no_gain: ℹ️ Compression did not reduce size. Original kept.
